title: Home page Lights tab: try each mix (round 2c)

steps.headline: Switch a light, dim it, change its colour. Which mix feels simplest to use?
steps.notice: In Destin's Room, tap a light to switch it, dim it with the bar (or by dragging the tile in Slide tiles), and press its colour dot. The TV backlight is unreachable; try it.
steps.risk: Everything here is practice data; nothing reaches a real light.

variants.label: Tall cards
variants.summary: Portrait cards, about three per line, in the same calm glass as the rows: bulb, name, percent and a colour dot on top, and the thick bar along the bottom. Tap the card to switch the light; use the bar to dim it. The dot opens a floating colour panel.
variants.risk: Tallest card of the three, and the unreachable light gets a full-size card of its own. Names that are long wrap onto two lines. On a phone two cards fit per line.

variants.label: Slide tiles
variants.summary: Wide tiles, two per line, with the rows' name and percent on a calm surface. The whole tile is the bar: a soft tint fills it to show how bright the light is, with a thin bright edge at the level. Tap to switch, drag sideways to dim.
variants.risk: Shortest card, but there is no bar to look at. Tap and drag share one surface, so a slow, wobbly tap can dim a light instead of switching it. Long names wrap onto several lines.

variants.label: Half rows
variants.summary: Exactly the roomy rows, at half the width, two lights per line: bulb, name, percent, colour dot and the thick bar. Tap the bulb or name to switch; the bar dims. The dot opens a floating colour panel.
variants.risk: Most like the rows you liked, but names squeeze, so long ones wrap onto two lines. On a phone the lights go back to one per line.
